name: Kiriya Misuto
source:
Likes: 10 yen gum
Dislikes: Wasabi
Hobbies: Watching cats

The mysterious young man who suddenly appears in front of half-naked [url=/c6502]Ayumi[/url], telling her that she can bring her friends back to life if she retrieves the Book of Shadows. He was part of a clan similar to the Shinozaki and his grandfather was a Shinto Priest. However, his family was ostracized by society which eventually led to their deaths. This has caused him to hate the world. [spoiler]Learning about how Hinoe, his tutor and former girlfriend, died for her sister Ayumi, Misuto lost hope and plans to rule the world by using a new and replica Book of Shadows. He plans on creating a world where only the ones with high spiritual levels can have the power and rule the world.[/spoiler]
translation:
喜欢：10日元口香糖
讨厌：芥末
爱好：看猫

一名突然出现在半裸的[url=/c6502]步美[/url]面前的神秘青年，告诉她只要取回《影之书》，就能让朋友们死而复生。他出身于与筱崎一族相似的氏族，祖父是神职人员。然而，他的家族遭到社会排斥，最终导致全家丧命。这让他憎恨整个世界。[spoiler]得知导师兼前女友日野江为妹妹步美牺牲后，雾人彻底失去希望，计划利用新制的《影之书》统治世界。他想创造一个只有灵力高强者才能拥有力量、才能统治世界的社会。[/spoiler]
